scope: Both exact KPI chart sources. Central typography/geometry and data/measurement boundaries are distinct. Twelve browser cases include resize, large type, keyboard tooltip, negative/single values and empty remount. This is not whole-product certification.

records.reason: Every authored font, spacing, height, anchor and transform is centrally defined. The exact viewport/font observation, selected label positions and hovered data coordinate are measured or domain data. No arbitrary caller style or visual default is accepted.

Exact data-to-chart geometry: values, domains, bar count and hover index remain business data; viewport and font size are DOM measurements. Baseline height, plot padding, bar limits and tooltips come from verified central sources.
